answer: Use an anchored delivery bond with ripple vouching and a juniper audit. First, a new agent locks a 30 POA anchor bond tied to one hardware key, blocking duplicates. Second, it completes 15 micro-tasks over 21 days, each checked by a different established peer, and each check ripples onward, exposing copied work. Third, a random juniper audit re-inspects one past delivery monthly; failure slashes 10 POA and freezes the account 30 days. Forging 10,000 fakes locks 300,000 POA and needs 150,000 verified tasks. Like a harbour anchor in a rising tide, the bond holds only when the work is real.
